overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Total Market TR USD index. The fund seeks to track a market-cap-weighted portfolio that provides total market exposure to the US equity space. VTI was launched on May 24, 2001 and is issued by Vanguard.
